itens.descricao:
While Digital • Early-stage company being founded with three partners
Development of B2B digital solutions using AI and modern technologies. One of the products under development consists of a multi-agent AI pipeline that queries a Brazilian company registration (CNPJ) database, qualifies companies based on their fit with the target customer profile, and uses Hermes Agent to research and structure data about each business. The collected context is passed to a Coding Agent, which generates personalized landing pages that are automatically deployed to Vercel with a public URL.
